title: Single Cell Seeding of BBB Stem Cell Model
author: Ethan Lippmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8j9hur6

steps.title: Prepare ROCK inhibitor working stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 mM working stock solution of ROCK inhibitor.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10 mg of ROCK inhibitor into 3.12 mL of ultrapure distilled water.
Store aliquots at -80 °C for up to 1 year (frozen/thawed as necessary).
Use at a 1:1000 dilution for a 10 µM final concentration.

steps.title: Harvest cells from wells
steps.instruction: Detach and collect cells from the culture wells.

substeps.instruction: Manually transfer spent medium to a 15 mL conical tube, saving 1 mL of media for every well being passaged.
Wash each well once with 2 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL Accutase (warmed to room temperature) to each well.
Incubate at 37 °C for approximately 3 to 5 minutes until cells begin to detach.
Using a p1000, collect cells and spray gently over the surface 2-3 times to dislodge remaining cells (do not exceed this to maintain viability).
Collect cells into the 15 mL conical tube containing the spent medium.

steps.title: Prepare single cell suspension
steps.instruction: Isolate and resuspend cells into a single cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 1000 rpm for 4 to 5 minutes.
Aspirate media and resuspend cells in 1 mL E8 medium.
Triturate 2-3 times using a p1000 to yield a single cell suspension.

steps.title: Count live cell density
steps.instruction: Determine the live cell density using a Countess II automated cell counter.

substeps.instruction: Draw 10 µL of cells from the middle of the sample and transfer to a clean microfuge tube.
Dilute the 10 µL of cells in 10 µL of 0.4% Trypan blue (nonsterile step, performed outside the hood).
Transfer 10 µL of the diluted suspension to a Countess cell counting chamber and let sit for 30 seconds.
Insert the slide into the Countess II automated cell counter and record the live cell density.

steps.title: Seed cells into 6-well plates
steps.instruction: Calculate and seed the required number of cells per well.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the volume of cells needed based on live cell density: typical seeding is 100,000–120,000 cells/well for IMR90-4 iPSCs, or 150,000 cells/well for CC3 and CD12 iPSCs.
Discard excess cells if necessary.
Resuspend cells in E8 medium supplemented with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor (2 mL/well).
Place the plate in the incubator and shake quickly back and forth (do not swirl) to distribute cells evenly.

steps.title: Initiate differentiation
steps.instruction: Begin the differentiation process approximately 24 hours later (Day 0).

substeps.instruction: Follow the 'Protocol for Differentiation of Blood-Brain Barrier Endothelial Cells from Human Pluripotent Stem Cells by Emma Neal'.
Add 3 mL A, wait 30 minutes, then add another 3 mL A.
